title: pm-dispatch(execution-duties): cut fleet spend — no chasing `main`, `xhigh` by phase via subagent, event-woken idle seats, no stacked dispatch, seat sessions at the judgment tier
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8

Filing gate: ③ 维护者直派 (pm rule change, filed because the maintainer named it). Priority p1 by the maintainer's word 「都是 p1」.

Blocked-by: #32784

Maintainer's words, verbatim (Elon, project thread 「评估车队如何节约 token」, 2026-11-12, UTC):
- 21:46:10Z 「任务很多，评估如何节约 token」
- 21:47:28Z his five measures: 「只在落地前合一次 main，中间不追」「只在设计、复读和红线检查时用 xhigh，写代码和修门禁降到 high，nit 继续用 medium」「把共用的部分压成一页摘要」「空闲的座位把巡逻间隔拉长，或者有新信件再唤醒」「互相依赖的卡串着做，不同时开」
- 21:50:27Z 「以上建议用 fable评审，然后立skills 卡优化」
- 21:54:51Z 「…按照你的意见补充立卡并全部交给 skills 车道 派发。都是 p1」
- 21:55:16Z 「32847 给你参考。冲突的话可以关闭 32847」

Measured spend (session usage readings, 2026-11-12): cache reads are 65–78% of every Opus session's cost, cache writes 11–25%, output 10–14%, so a session's cost ≈ context size × model calls. Seats reach 225–262k context within 15–40 min of seating; server seat 1 (11-05→06, 25 h) cost $272 with 521M cache-read tokens and a 347k peak. M cards cost $11.7–15.3, S cards $2.4. The proposals were reviewed read-only at the contract tier (`/mnt/project-files/token-savings/fable-review-2026-11-12.md` in the fleet project); this card carries the adopted form. Supersedes #32847, which is closed: its Part 2 had card threads switch effort mid-thread (a project thread's effort is fixed at spawn) and its Part 3 adds a third copy of the rules (「⛔ 不另抄」).

**Business reason.** The fleet stopped on usage walls (11-01→11-05, 11-09). These five rules are the repeat costs that buy no correctness; on the same budget more cards land per day. Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` seat (os-dev on `references/**`; contract-tier review). `Blocked-by: #32784` because Part 2 edits the effort lines PR #32845 amends.

## Part 1 — merge `main` into an open PR once, before landing (`execution-duties.md:37`, `landing-operations.md` 〈D〉)
Evidence: PR #32577 merged `origin/main` 5 times in ~10 h on 2026-11-12, each followed by a full local gate re-run. AGENTS.md §10 already says merge only on a GitHub-reported conflict, a `main`-caused red or a queue removal, then scoped re-checks; the seat text that dispatch orders are written from does not.
Wanted, in place at :37: 「② 开 PR 前合一次 main;③ 兄弟卡落地后再合一次;其间 ⛔ 不追 main,`behind` 不是理由,入队前再合只按 landing-operations 的 K 判据。」 A dispatch order, brief or re-read request ⛔ never orders a proactive merge; after a lawful merge the local re-check is AGENTS.md §10's scoped set, and 〈D〉's 「全套验证」 reads the same way. Keep the K≥15 / new-locale-bundle and 〈A〉 regenerate exceptions.

## Part 2 — `xhigh` by phase, through an isolated subagent (`execution-duties.md:126-127`)
A project thread's effort is fixed at spawn, so a thread cannot switch effort between phases. p1 is a priority, not a difficulty.
Wanted: 「S 机械与 nit 返工 `medium`;M/L 施工与修门禁 `high`(默认);XL/security/契约复核/四轴分析/ADR `xhigh`;`max` 凭点名。线程恒按施工档开,设计与红线重读起隔离子代理传 `xhigh`。」 Keep 「拿不准升一档」 so an L card does not pay a REWORK round for the saving. Standing `xhigh` orders for security and ADR amendments are unchanged.

## Part 3 — idle seats are woken by events; fallback patrol every 4–6 h (`execution-duties.md:165`, `seat-post-protocol.md:65`)
Evidence: a 60–70 min interval is just past the prompt-cache lifetime, so every fire re-writes the seat's whole ~250k context before reading anything: the most expensive interval there is. Seven hourly patrols ran on 2026-11-12.
Wanted at :165: 「② Routine 席在飞期间主巡检间隔 ≤45 分钟;待命期由信箱与 PR 事件唤醒,兜底巡查每 4–6 小时一次跑待命五项;节奏维护者明示可改。」 Idle = no in-flight card or PR, no unread letter, no lane candidate at the last fire; the seat records the stretched cron on its `Patrol:` stub line; an idle fire that finds nothing ends after the probe; the first wake with work restores the normal interval. Still ⛔ never stopped by "N fires without change" (`seat-lifecycle.md:87`); a pure "mail-only" wake is not enough because a `Restart-when:` that comes true sends no letter.

## Part 4 — a card whose PR would stack on an unmerged PR is not dispatched (`execution-duties.md:33-36`)
Evidence (from #32847): PR #32811 stacked on #32808; every move of the upstream made the downstream re-merge and re-run.
Wanted: a card whose PR would stack on another open PR's branch, or whose `Blocked-by:` names an unmerged card/PR, gets no card thread until that PR merges, unless the maintainer orders a build-ahead. Half-line at :33: 「串行后卡在前卡 MERGED 前 ⛔ 不开线程。」 〈C〉's draft parking stays for a PR already written when its dependency appeared. The concurrency cap is unchanged.

## Part 5 — seat sessions run at the judgment tier (`execution-duties.md:122`)
Evidence: the contract tier costs about 3× the default per token, and a seat session re-reads its whole context on every call; today `:122` keeps the skills seat itself at the contract tier.
Wanted: 「席位档策略:全部执行席与分诊席默认判断档会话;契约复审档只经隔离子代理或卡线程按卡取用。」 Unchanged: the 2026-09-10 ruling 「必须 fable的还包括对外发布的skills」 — cards touching published `skills/**` are still built and reviewed at the contract tier (`dispatch-gates.data.mjs` rows untouched).

## Acceptance
- The five parts are in the skill text, each citing the maintainer's 2026-11-12 words; AGENTS.md untouched.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` green. Every target file is at its line ceiling (execution-duties 189, landing-operations 107, seat-post-protocol at cap): each new line is paid by a same-file deletion or an in-place rewrite. ⛔ No re-wrap to find a line. No `scripts/` gate quotes the rewritten sentences (checked).
- skip-changeset (`.claude/**` is not published). Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none.

Dedupe (open AND closed): #32847 (closed by this card, superseded); `is:issue "merge main" in:title` → 35 hits, nearest #23390 (closed, AGENTS.md §10) and #31548 (closed, K bar); `is:issue effort in:title` → nearest #32784 (open, blocks Part 2); `is:issue patrol interval` → nearest #25991 (closed); `is:issue seat tier fable in:title` → 2 hits (#27265, #14303, both closed, unrelated). **New.**
